name: EKTORP 3-seat sofa, Hakebo dark grey

research.selectedReason: Official IKEA GB product page reachable at task time, publishing complete outer measurements for a single fixed variant. The 2180 mm width sits inside the authored living room's 4500 mm north wall, so it exercises the fit check without failing it.

rejected.reason: 2520 x 1630 mm chaise version leaves under 800 mm walking clearance in the authored living room
